title: Grateful Dead Live at Davis Gymnasium on 1971-04-14
source: Recording Info: SBD > MR > ? > DAT > CDR; Transfer Info: CDR > WAV > Sound Forge 10 > TLH > Flac; Cleaned up, retracked, remastered version of shnid 6250. Cleaned up, retracked and mastered by Bill Guarneri, August 9, 2014

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording of a hot, gold‑mine performance highlighted by a smoking The Other One and an explosive Bird Song opener.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the setlist and energy, calling the show a "gold mine" with standout moments like The Other One, Bird Song, and the China Cat > I Know You Rider sequence. No specific recording issues are mentioned, suggesting a clean soundboard source that captures the excitement well.

ai_rating.rationale: One reviewer gives 5 stars praising performance; another rates 3 stars with only a brief highlight, yielding an average around 4 and indicating generally positive but not unanimous enthusiasm.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No complaints about clarity or mix; assumed clean soundboard capture.

standout_songs: China Cat > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: Enthusiastic, near‑perfect set list with a strong second‑set opener (Bird Song) and high‑energy transitions throughout.
